# WayForWhitecoat — Full Content Guide for LLMs

> WayForWhitecoat is an MBBS-abroad education consultancy for Indian (and South-Asian) students. It guides students to NMC- and WHO-recognised medical universities in 26+ countries and supports the whole journey: counselling, university selection, eligibility checks, applications, fees planning, scholarships, and student-visa processing.

## About the organisation

- Name: WayForWhitecoat
- Sector: Overseas medical education consultancy (MBBS abroad)
- Primary audience: Indian students seeking an MBBS/MD degree abroad
- Value proposition: Globally recognised universities, transparent fees, honest counselling, end-to-end admission and visa support
- Countries covered: Armenia, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bulgaria, China, Egypt, France, Georgia, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Lithuania, Malaysia, Nepal, Netherlands, Romania, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Tajikistan, UAE, UK, Uzbekistan, Philippines

## Services

- Free career counselling and country/university selection
- Eligibility assessment (NEET, academics)
- Application and admission processing
- Fees, budgeting and scholarship guidance
- Student-visa assistance and pre-departure support

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/): Entry point summarising services and destinations.
- [About Us](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/about.html): Mission, approach and counselling process.
- [MBBS Abroad Destinations](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/countries.html): Compare all countries for studying MBBS.
- [Gallery](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/gallery.html): Student success stories and events.
- [Contact](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/contact.html): Free counselling enquiry.
